text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Number one in the world. The ultimate battlefield where unyielding pride clashed and sparks flew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While generous applause rained down on the victor,
<chrname> stood frozen
upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rush over to <chrname>.
And then, she—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A fighting spirit ignited in those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> nods.
She channels even her frustration into pure drive.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Let's take on the challenge, as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "That is what we're here for. That is why Project L'Arc exists."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—As long as you desire it,
let's aim to be the best in the world.
